name: bamster
description: BAMster - A Tetris-meets-platformer game with a hamster and laser pistol

scripts.cap:android: pnpm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: pnpm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:build:android: pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:build:ios: pnpm run cap:sync && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator'
